descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating Ashdod (אַשְׁדּוֹד), one of the five principal cities of the Philistine pentapolis, located on the Mediterranean coastal plain. A major military and cultic center; the ark of God was brought there (1 Sam 5:1-7), Uzziah broke down its walls (2 Chr 26:6), Isaiah prophesied against it (Isa 20:1), Jeremiah listed it among nations to drink God's cup of wrath (Jer 25:20), Amos threatened judgment (Amos 1:8, 3:9), Zephaniah and Zechariah pronounced oracles against it (Zeph 2:4, Zech 9:6), and Joshua allotted territory near it (Josh 11:22, 15:46-47). All auto-split clusters represent the same toponym with different Hebrew prepositions (bare, ב 'in', ל 'to/for', מ 'from', directional ה-locale suffix): arb أشدود, deu/eng/fra Ashdod, hin अशदोद/अश्दोद, kor 아스돗, spa Asdod/Ashdod.
